description: A stated position in favor (first person; "I do not support" does not match).
A stated position against (first person, "vote no", "I don't support").
"I support data centers but not here / not this site": support, a turn (but/however), then a place objection.
A condition on the position: only if, as long as, provided that, with conditions. Cue = phrase plus up to six words.
An objection left open to terms: unless, open to, would reconsider. Needs an oppose cue. Cue = phrase plus up to six words.
